name: Harbor Camps Summer Camp
description_short: An overnight lakefront camp in New Hampshire for transgender and non-binary youth. It offers traditional camp activities and does not formally talk about gender. New campers must be ages 8-14, and returning campers can attend through age 15.
special_needs_notes: The camp says it is not a therapeutic camp and is meant for kids who can be self-sufficient with help from counselors. At least two nurses and several health assistants are on site 24 hours a day and give medication as needed. The kitchen can handle allergen-free, vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free meals. Campers choose bunkmates with similar or varied gender identities, and restrooms and showers are private.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp has a mile of frontage on a 200-acre lake. Activities include swimming, canoeing, kayaking, stand-up paddle boarding and tubing behind a speed boat.

warnings: Two weekly rates are listed: a full rate of $1,725 and an honor-system subsidized rate of $1,170. price_per_week is set to the full rate. Financial aid is also available on top of these.
Session registration_opens_at uses the new-camper date (October 15, 2026). Applications for returning campers open October 1, 2026.
The age range differs by camper. New campers must be ages 8-14 at their first summer. Returning campers can attend through age 15. Campers 15 and older must have started by age 14.
The off-season office address is a P.O. Box in Westminster, CO, but the camp itself is in New Hampshire. The P.O. Box was not recorded as the camp's address.
Bus service from Boston-Logan Airport costs extra: $125 each way.
